title: Workflows
description: Build, validate and run governed automation graphs.

list.title: Workflow catalog
list.description: Every workflow is versioned and bound to an approval-ready plan hash.
list.name: Name
list.emptyHint: Create a workflow to start composing a governed automation graph.
list.forbidden: You are not authorized to view workflows.

create.title: Create workflow
create.description: Declare the workflow first, then add its steps in the editor.
create.name: Name

editor.loadFailed: The workflow could not be loaded.
editor.selectHint: Select a node to edit its configuration and dependencies.
editor.enableHint: Disabled workflows cannot start new runs.
editor.optionsTruncatedHint: There are more than shown, so this picker is incomplete: a schedule or route missing here may still exist. Narrow the workflow or pick it by id.

add.title: Add step
add.description: Choose a unique reference and one supported action.
add.duplicate: That reference is already in use.

deps.title: Dependencies
deps.description: This step runs after every selected predecessor.
deps.limit: A step can have at most 8 dependencies.

validation.refInvalid: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens; start with a letter or number.
validation.labelTooLong: The event label must be at most 200 characters.
validation.secondsRange: Seconds must be a whole number from 1 to 86400.
validation.reasonTooLong: The approval reason must be at most 200 characters.
validation.fanIn: This step has more than 8 dependencies.
validation.fanOut: This step feeds more than 8 dependent steps.
validation.selfDependency: A step cannot depend on itself.
validation.unknownDependency: A dependency references an unknown step.
validation.duplicateDependency: The same dependency is listed more than once.
validation.cycle: This node is part of a dependency cycle.

dryRun.title: Dry-run plan
dryRun.description: Read-only plan with no dispatches or other effects.
dryRun.empty: This workflow has no planned steps.
dryRun.failed: The dry run could not be generated.

run.title: Run workflow
run.description: Runs require a governance approval bound to the current plan.
run.approvalHint: Resolve this approval in Governance, then return here to execute the unchanged plan.
run.forbidden: Approval was denied, is still pending, or no longer matches this plan. Review it in Governance and request a new approval if the graph changed.
run.locked: The emergency kill switch is active. The workflow was not run.
run.conflict: The workflow is disabled or has no steps, so it cannot run.
run.historyFailed: The run history could not be loaded.

revisions.title: Revision history — {{name}}
revisions.description: Compare immutable workflow snapshots or restore one.
revisions.restoreDescription: The selected snapshot will become the current workflow and create a new audit revision.
